courses.title: SAT Math

courses.description: The 1600 Project's SAT Math lessons as slides: the four-week Foundations series, a lesson for every Math domain (Algebra, Advanced Math, Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Geometry and Trigonometry), mixed practice and calculator strategy, and two Desmos toolkits. Worked examples, common traps and exit tickets in every lesson.

courses.description: The 1600 Project's SAT Reading and Writing lessons as slides: the four-week ELA Foundations series, a lesson for every question type in the four Reading and Writing domains, and mixed-domain practice with pacing and a strategy review. Worked examples with explained answers and common traps in every lesson.
